title: Concept: API description advertising an internal server
description: An OpenAPI document whose servers list names an internal host in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The document hands over the full route list and the host that serves it, so an attacker can target the internal endpoint directly instead of guessing routes.
applicability: Deployments that render an OpenAPI document whose servers list names an internal host into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The document hands over the full route list and the host that serves it, so an attacker can target the internal endpoint directly instead of guessing routes.
